title: Legal evidence + owner adoption register
decision: Owner decision, 6 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001): no solicitor is commissioned at this stage; GS-O003's mandatory solicitor approval is replaced by an evidence-based review of each document against current UK legislation and official guidance, followed by explicit owner adoption. Nothing in this register claims solicitor review, certification or guaranteed enforceability.
rules: Only the owner moves a document to OWNER_ADOPTED, by recording ownerAdoptedOn (date) and ownerAdoptedVersion (the exact version adopted). No script sets either.
PUBLISHABLE requires OWNER_ADOPTED plus a passing check:legal:adoption run on the adopted version; ownerAdoptedVersion must equal the document's version.
scripts/migrate-production-cms.mjs admits a legal document to the production payload only at PUBLISHABLE.

An adopted entry records adoptionAuthority (the owner's instruction) and its publicationPrerequisites; PUBLISHABLE is refused while any prerequisite has no recorded evidence in prerequisitesMet. Adoption is never inferred: a document carrying an open marker cannot be OWNER_ADOPTED.

GS-LEGAL-001-R4 review: an adoption is bound to the adopted text by ownerAdoptedSha256 (the draft file's sha256, or for client-terms the sha256 of its generated content); check:legal:adoption refuses an adopted entry whose text no longer matches, so an edit that keeps the version number cannot keep the adoption. Privacy, when adopted, must list H4-B-INTAKE-PROMOTED and does not list itself.

GS-LEGAL-001-R6: an adopted document that describes an operation as already happening needs recorded evidence of it at adoption (REQUIRED_ADOPTION_EVIDENCE). Privacy needs RETENTION-ROUTINE-OPERATING, because its section 8 describes the scheduled retention reviews.

GS-LEGAL-001-R6 review: privacy adoption also needs HOSTINGER-PROCESSOR-CHAIN evidence (a signed Gridsmith processing agreement with the account holder, or the account transfer), so removing the section 6 marker alone cannot unblock adoption. (Redefined at GS-LEGAL-001-R7; see the next rule.)

GS-LEGAL-001-R7: HOSTINGER-PROCESSOR-CHAIN is redefined, not removed. The Hostinger subscription holder is not a processor merely because it bought and holds the plan. The evidence records (a) the owner's confirmation that no person other than Atik Murtaza holds access to the Hostinger account or the mailbox, that the account's contact email is controlled by him or by Gridsmith, and that he manages the gridsmith.uk hosting for Gridsmith; and (b) Gridsmith Ltd made Hostinger's Customer (recommended), or an interim written arrangement under Hostinger DPA section 2.2, which also requires the Privacy sections 6 and 7 to be revised first, with a date. Gridsmith relies on Hostinger's transfer safeguards only once (b) is in place (docs/_legal/operations/PROCESSOR-REGISTER.md).
stateRecord: 6 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001): all seven moved to OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED on Agent G's re-verification (research/GS-LEGAL-001/G-final-cross-check.md section 7). 7 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001-R3): the owner decisions in research/GS-LEGAL-001/R2-OWNER-DECISION-PACK.md section 4 were applied (research/GS-LEGAL-001/R3-OWNER-DECISIONS-APPLIED.md); the client terms for consumers and for business clients moved to version 3.1, the other five are unchanged; all seven remain OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED, and six of them now need only the owner's adoption. The privacy policy still carries three [OWNER DECISION] markers (processor terms, transfer safeguard, retention) that wait on owner account checks and on the retention routine operating, so it is not adoptable. No document is OWNER_ADOPTED. 7 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001-R4): on the owner's instruction, six documents are OWNER_ADOPTED (business-client-terms 3.1, consumer-client-terms 3.1, terms 2.1, cookies 2.1, accessibility 2.1, client-terms 2.1), each with its publication prerequisites listed and none met; none is PUBLISHABLE. The privacy policy is not adopted and remains OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED with its three markers (research/GS-LEGAL-001/R4-OWNER-ADOPTION.md). 7 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001-R5): evidence sweep only; no state, version or adopted text changed. The privacy policy remains OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED with its three markers; its 2.2 readiness and the four remaining owner checks are in research/GS-LEGAL-001/R5-PRIVACY-EVIDENCE.md. 7 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001-R6): the privacy policy draft moved to version 2.2 (owner evidence applied; one [OWNER DECISION] marker remains on the Hostinger account-holder arrangement). It stays OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED with no adoption fields. Adoption now also needs recorded evidence for RETENTION-ROUTINE-OPERATING and HOSTINGER-PROCESSOR-CHAIN (research/GS-LEGAL-001/R6-PRIVACY-2.2-DRAFT.md). 7 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001-R7): the R6 classification of the Hostinger subscription holder as a processor was withdrawn, and the privacy policy 2.2 draft lost its last [OWNER DECISION] marker and one sentence. It stays OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED with no adoption fields, because RETENTION-ROUTINE-OPERATING and HOSTINGER-PROCESSOR-CHAIN have no recorded evidence. The 63 Production probe leads were deleted under the retention cleanup (the routine is not yet operating), and the seven development legal documents were reseeded (research/GS-LEGAL-001/R7-HOSTINGER-RETENTION.md). The six adopted documents are unchanged.
